name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 58 – Am 65
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 58a. Notes with concern that so-called ‘wokeism’ and the resulting cancel culture widens societal divisions, discourages open and frank discourse, leads to a reductionist view of history, promotes censorship, historical revisionism, and inevitably curtails freedom of expression;
